author: Arcani test fixtures
rationale: Loop fixture (Story 2.7): learn mode, max run time 20 min, length 1200 s, opening 60 s, body 90 s. Theta reference: a 450 Hz carrier amplitude-modulated by the sine envelope at a fixed 4 Hz theta rate, 75 percent AM depth. Binaural layer: a 100 Hz pure sine in the left ear and a pure sine in the right ear whose beat rate cycles over 0 to 3 Hz every 60 s (center 1.5 Hz, swing 1.5 Hz, start phase 270 degrees). Compile rejects it: /loop/body_s loop body not whole rate cycles (a whole multiple of 60 s (/binaural/beat_rate_cycle/period_s)). Values are placeholders, not starter defaults. A test fixture, not for listening.
